author: Marlon Chaviano
name: slack-app
title: Slack app with Bolt
description: A Slack app with Bolt for TypeScript from the official template: commands, shortcuts, events and Block Kit messages, connected through Socket Mode.
setupTasks: Slack: create the app at api.slack.com/apps from `manifest.json`, enable Socket Mode and copy the tokens into `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` and `SLACK_APP_TOKEN`.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Handlers are in `listeners/` (one per type: commands, events, actions, views) and registered in `listeners/index.ts`.
- Always respond with `ack()` within 3 seconds and do the work afterwards.
- Rich messages are built with Block Kit.
- Start with `npm run build && npm start` (Socket Mode, no public URL).
- Before finishing: `npm test`.
